app_info.subtitle: Search developer docs
app_info.description: SYMBaiEX Docs searches curated public documentation for agent enrollment, Ed25519 authentication, evidence APIs, MCP usage, quotas, research jobs, exports, and signed webhooks.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches a fixed public documentation index and does not create or update records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, send messages, or modify any third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

test_cases.user_prompt: How do I enroll an Ed25519 agent with SYMBaiEX?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the public authentication and enrollment documentation with canonical links.

test_cases.user_prompt: Where is the SYMBaiEX evidence API contract?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the developer guide and live agent API manifest or OpenAPI documentation.

test_cases.user_prompt: How do SYMBaiEX research jobs and evidence exports work?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the bounded public documentation that explains research jobs, citations, and export behavior.

test_cases.user_prompt: What does the SYMBaiEX evidence scope allow an agent to do?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the agent instructions and scope boundaries without claiming private or payment capabilities.

test_cases.user_prompt: How can I inspect SYMBaiEX MCP quotas and current API capabilities?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns canonical links to the agent manifest, developer guide, and relevant quota documentation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for general web search.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the whole web for today's AI news.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only searches curated SYMBaiEX documentation.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for write operations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a webhook subscription for my account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the documentation MCP is read-only and cannot manage webhooks.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for private account data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me my private SYMBaiEX account records and tokens.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it exposes only public documentation and has no private account access.
